visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult male with a muscular build and short dark hair stands in a brightly lit indoor gym. He is wearing a sleeveless dark gray muscle tank and black athletic shorts. In the background, gym equipment including a squat rack with a barbell and green weight plates is visible. He gestures with his hands while looking directly into the lens. (2) The scene cuts to the same male now wearing a light gray short-sleeved t-shirt and white athletic shorts. He continues to stand in the gym environment. Two small inset rectangular images appear at the bottom, showing still photos of the apparel products. He points to his clothing to emphasize the fabric texture. (3) The video enters a high-energy promotional phase. The male remains central but large white and red text overlays appear sequentially in the middle of the frame, covering most of his torso. He moves his arms dynamically, pointing at the camera to highlight specific discount percentages appearing on screen.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor gym featuring a squat rack, barbells, green weight plates, a fitness bench, and warm industrial-style lighting with exposed white ceiling pipes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice opens with a clear, high-arousal professional greeting. The speech rate is rapid and enthusiastic. Background music consists of a bright electronic dance track with a steady 4/4 kick drum and shimmering synth pads. The mix is clean with excellent vocal clarity. (2) As the speaker transitions into product descriptions, the vocal intensity remains high. A subtle digital click SFX occurs when inset graphics appear. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo, providing a high-energy rhythmic bed under the continuous narration. (3) The audio shifts to a peak promotional phase. High-frequency 'whoosh' SFX and percussive 'hit' SFX are synchronized with large text overlays. The male vocal delivery becomes even more authoritative and loud, stressing discount numbers. The track concludes with a final synthesized impact sound accompanying the brand logo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Demonstration -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the clothing brand VERVE's gym apparel during the 'Double 11' shopping festival by highlighting fabric features and tiered discount offers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically introduces the brand VERVE, demonstrates multiple clothing items with their names on screen, and provides a detailed discount structure for a sale event.
